proposal.description: The comparator flag entering the blanking history is copied across the whole cp_delay register instead of being zero-extended into bit 0, so a high cp_sync reaches the tap cp_delay[BLANK_CLKS-1] on the next clock instead of BLANK_CLKS clocks later.
proposal.reason: In S_SS or S_RUN, a cp_sync pulse in the last BLANK_CLKS-1 clocks before pwm_rise (the switch-node slew the blanking exists to ignore) is counted as a faulted cycle. fault_count_run_out / fault_count_ss_out rise, and window_trip / window_trip_SS can assert, where the original reads the comparator from BLANK_CLKS clocks earlier and records a clean cycle.

proposal.description: The blanking history is written as a rotate instead of a shift, so the oldest comparator bit at cp_delay[BLANK_CLKS-1] comes back into bit 0 instead of being dropped.
proposal.reason: Once cp_sync is high for one clock in S_SS or S_RUN, the set bit keeps going round cp_delay, so every later pwm_rise sample reads as faulted until the next idle clear. The fault counts climb to a full window and window_trip / window_trip_SS assert after a single brief comparator pulse.
